cases.d: The Secretary builds the agenda: add, edit, reorder and delete items.
steps: Open tab "Nội dung cuộc họp" and click "Thêm nội dung".
Enter Nội dung cần bàn: Dự toán ngân sách năm 2027, choose Người trình bày, click Lưu.
Add two more items and drag one to a new position ("Kéo để đổi vị trí").
Edit an item ("Sửa"), then delete one ("Xoá nội dung").
exp: Toasts "Tạo mục nghị sự thành công.", "Sắp xếp mục nghị sự thành công.", "Cập nhật mục nghị sự thành công." and "Xóa mục nghị sự thành công." appear.
Without a title: "Vui lòng nhập nội dung cần bàn.".
Other participants see the agenda update live.
pre: A Draft or Published meeting with documents; signed in as its Secretary.

cases.d: The Chair runs the agenda during the meeting and records conclusions.
steps: Start the meeting as the Chair.
Start the first item, then try to start a second one.
Click "Ghi kết luận", enter a conclusion and click "Lưu kết luận".
exp: Starting a second item shows "Đã có mục nghị sự đang diễn ra.".
The completed item is marked done with actual times.
"Lưu kết luận mục nghị sự thành công." appears and the item shows "Đã kết luận".
pre: A Published meeting with agenda items; chutoa is Chair.

cases.d: An empty agenda guides the Secretary and members only read it.
steps: As the Secretary, open tab "Nội dung cuộc họp" of a meeting with no item.
As thanhvien, open the same tab of the published meeting.
exp: The Secretary sees "Chưa có nội dung nào" with "Thêm các nội dung cần bàn trong cuộc họp." and "Thêm nội dung".
The member sees the items but no add, edit, delete or drag actions.
pre: A published meeting; thanhvien is invited.

cases.d: Closing the item form with unsaved changes asks first.
steps: Open "Sửa" on an item, change the title and close the dialog.
Choose "Tiếp tục sửa", close again and choose "Bỏ thay đổi".
exp: "Bỏ thay đổi chưa lưu?" is asked.
"Bỏ thay đổi" closes without saving; the item keeps its old title.
pre: Signed in as the meeting Secretary; the agenda has items.

cases.d: The agenda is locked once the meeting has ended.
steps: Open tab "Nội dung cuộc họp" of an ended meeting as its Secretary.
exp: No add, edit, delete or drag action is offered.
pre: An ended meeting with agenda items.

cases.d: A presenter is notified when assigned to an item of a published meeting.
steps: As the Secretary, edit an item and choose thanhvien as Người trình bày; save.
As thanhvien, open the notification bell.
exp: thanhvien receives a notification about presenting the item.
Assigning yourself as presenter does not notify you.
pre: A published meeting with thanhvien invited.

cases.d: The Chair or Secretary adds documents to an agenda item from its paperclip.
steps: On an agenda item click the paperclip ("Thêm tài liệu").
Choose "Chọn từ tài liệu cuộc họp", tick a document and click "Gắn 1 tài liệu".
Open the paperclip again, choose "Tải tệp lên từ máy" and add a PDF; then "Chọn từ kho của tôi" and add a library document.
Sign in as thanhvien and open the agenda.
exp: The dialog "Thêm tài liệu cho mục 1" opens on the chosen source.
"Đã gắn tài liệu vào mục nghị sự." appears and the documents show under the item.
An uploaded or library document is also added to the meeting's documents.
thanhvien sees the documents but no paperclip; after the meeting ends nobody can add documents.
pre: A Published or InProgress meeting with agenda items and documents; signed in as chutoa or thuky.
